name: B10-0360/2025 (PPE) – Governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the United Nations to renew the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum, a yearly meeting where governments, companies and civil society discuss how the internet is run. That mandate runs out on 31 December 2025, and the UN General Assembly will review it in autumn 2025. The Parliament wants the mandate renewed permanently, with more resources, and wants the EU and its member states to keep supporting the forum. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the UN to renew the forum's mandate permanently and boost its funding.
- **Who it affects:** The UN, EU member states, the European Commission, and everyone who takes part in internet governance talks.
- **What happens next:** The UN General Assembly decides on the mandate in autumn 2025; the Parliament plans to keep sending members to future forum meetings.
